children: American Resources entered into an Asset Purchase Agreement to acquire certain real property, structures, fixtures, and equipment from Wyoming County Coal for $40.0 million, paid via settlement of pending litigation. The assets transfer free and clear of liens, with the deed to be executed within 60 days. The deal excludes mining permits and historical operating liabilities, including reclamation and AROs. American Resources plans to evaluate the property for critical-mineral recovery from legacy refuse materials, subject to permitting and commercial requirements.
